analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the financial year 2025-26, driven by an organic revenue growth of 73% to Rs. 84,9933 lakhs. EBITDA increased by 157% to Rs. 57,674 lakhs and PAT grew by 196% to Rs. 35,165 lakhs, despite challenging industry conditions and escalating bullion prices.

orders_capacity.claim: Maximum operational retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq. ft in February 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Maximum operational Retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft (February 2025)

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail space increased by 17.46% to reach 1,04,000 sq ft.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 6 per share of face value of Rs. 10, aggregating with the interim dividend to a total distribution of Rs. 10 per share for FY24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board after considering the funding requirements for 2024-25 both for capex and enlarged working capital requirements due to gold price increase by 12%, has recommended a final dividend of ` 6/- per share of face value of Rs.10/- aggregating to Rs.10/- per share as total distribution of dividend for the financial year 2023-24 on the doubled equity capital.

management_commitments.claim: The company has a plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
management_commitments.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

management_commitments.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26.
management_commitments.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

management_commitments.claim: The company planned to open the flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
management_commitments.quote: To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

management_commitments.claim: The company planned to complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.
management_commitments.quote: To complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted to further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales.
management_commitments.quote: Further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted to improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted to improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
